subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram native Thinking indicator via Bot API 10.2

question: Should Telegram gain an opt-in Bot API 10.2 rich Thinking draft for generic in-progress status despite the current one-editable-preview policy and retired native-draft preview path?
rationale: The upstream API supports the proposed behavior, but current OpenClaw policy intentionally favors one persistent editable preview and compatibility-aware rich delivery; choosing a second ephemeral lifecycle is a product and transport-policy decision.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow opt-in progress draft
options.body: Extend only Telegram progress status in eligible private chats, keep the existing preview lifecycle as the default, and never stream answer or reasoning content through the rich draft.

options.title: Keep the current preview policy
options.body: Retain editable previews and ordinary progress status, declining a separate native Thinking-draft lifecycle for now.

options.title: Design a broader native-draft mode
options.body: Approve a separate configuration mode only after defining upgrade, fallback, client-compatibility, and final-message semantics.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow opt-in progress draft
recommendation.body: Extend only Telegram progress status in eligible private chats, keep the existing preview lifecycle as the default, and never stream answer or reasoning content through the rich draft.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history signal for the adjacent Telegram progress/draft implementation.
